summary: Regression test after the refactor (meant to change no behaviour) of the admin dashboard, enquiry modal, ItemFormDialog, contexts, server.py and catalog.py. Backend suite: 50 of 52 pass. The 2 failures are the known email-provider 429 retry log-count tests. Before I fixed a test-only issue, 6 tests in test_xolnet_api.py errored because the session sent no X-Forwarded-For, so every run shared one enquiry rate-limit bucket. The frontend regressions all pass: enquiry modal, admin dashboard, content editor CRUD for courses and testimonials with image upload, theme toggle and footer social icons. I found no regression from the refactor. A few older bugs are listed below.

minor.issue: The email provider returns 429 rate_limited (environmental). The retry loop logs extra 'email/send' lines, so the 2 log-count tests in test_customer_email_whatsapp.py fail. In a parallel burst, about 11 lines read 'Email send error: ' with an empty message: the exception's str() is empty. Log type(e).__name__ / repr(e) instead. The enquiry API itself returned 200 quickly (emails are sent in the background).
Still overwrites the existing admin's password when it does not match ADMIN_PASSWORD. This breaks the playbook rule 'never change an existing admin's password' (older issue, reported in iteration_4).
ADMIN_EMAIL/ADMIN_PASSWORD read from os.environ.get with hardcoded defaults (admin@example.com/admin123). The config rule says to fail fast instead.

ui_bugs.issue: Number fields start at 0, so a new testimonial gets rating=0. Saving without touching the rating returns the 422 toast 'Input should be greater than or equal to 1'. Older bug, not a regression. Default the rating to 5 (for example via a per-field default in the config).

toPayloadValue splits list fields on newlines AND commas (/\n|,/). The label says 'one per line', yet seeded package features such as 'Posts, reels & stories' get split into 2 items on any edit and save. Older bug.

The interest field is only rendered while form.interest is non-empty (`{form.interest && <Field .../>}`). If the user clears the prefilled interest, the input disappears and can't be retyped. Older bug. Base the condition on the initial prefill instead.

integration_issues.flow: Admin dashboard status change while a status filter is active
integration_issues.issue: The optimistic patchLead does not re-apply filters. A lead moved out of the filtered status still shows in the filtered table until filters change. Minor UX issue.

action_items: Default the testimonial rating to 5 in ItemFormDialog / AdminContent config so 'Add Story' works without editing the rating
Split list fields on newlines only (labels say 'one per line'), to stop commas inside items breaking them up
Keep enquiry-interest visible after the user clears it
Optional: improve the send_email exception log (empty message); stop seed_admin overwriting an existing admin's password; remove the ADMIN_* env defaults
critical_code_review_comments: The refactor is clean: AdminDashboard is split into AdminHeader/LeadMetrics/LeadFilters/LeadTable/LeadDrawer/LeadNotes plus useLeads; EnquiryModal is split into EnquirySteps plus useEnquiryForm. Behaviour matches the old code.
useLeads: patchLead updates both leads and selected, so a new note appears immediately and is still there after reopening the drawer (verified).
useLeads.load runs metrics inside Promise.all, so a metrics failure also drops the lead list with a generic toast. Consider Promise.allSettled.
LeadNotes key uses at-by-text(0,20). Fine, but a note id from the backend would be sturdier.
catalog._storage_call retries on 404 with a fresh key. A truly missing object triggers 2 calls (fine since the db record is checked first).
server.py _assert_safe_email helpers are well split and behave correctly (emails are still attempted, sent in the background).
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_xolnet_api.py (session now sends a random X-Forwarded-For so the per-IP rate limit is not shared across runs)

success_rate.frontend: 100% of regression flows; 3 older bugs noted

seed_data_creation: None. Cleaned up TEST_ enquiries (2) and 3 test_stu_* student users. Catalog counts are back to 9/9/40/6/15.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run pytest with `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=...` (tests load backend/.env, which does not define it). pytest.ini forces -n 2; for serial runs use -n 0. Enquiry modal Back button: enquiry-back-btn. Dashboard selects: use get_by_role('option', name=..., exact=True) after clicking the trigger. Content editor delete uses window.confirm, so accept the dialog. Upload: set_input_files on image-field-file, then wait for image-field-url to start with /api/files/.
